description: Gold reference comparison: OP25 vs trunker on SRRCS IQ recording

op25_fsk4.notes: OP25 C4FM mode struggles with this simulcast recording

op25_cqpsk.notes: CQPSK demod is 81x better than C4FM on this simulcast signal. All TSBKs have correct NAC.

trunker_c4fm.notes: Much better than OP25 C4FM (different filter/timing config). 92% correct NAC.

trunker_cqpsk.notes: Similar TSBK count to C4FM but lower NAC accuracy. CQPSK chain needs tuning.

target.description: OP25 CQPSK (1224 TSBKs, 100% correct NAC) is the gold standard to match
target.gap_trunker_cqpsk: 352 TSBKs short (71.2% of target), NAC accuracy needs improvement
likely_issues: Gardner timing loop parameters may need tuning (gain_mu, gain_omega)
Costas loop alpha/beta may differ from OP25 defaults
FLL (frequency lock loop) not yet implemented in trunker
Slicer calibration from sync pattern may be suboptimal
